S081.name: Stress_Related_Maladaptive_Response
S081.description: Emotional or behavioral symptoms appearing in response to an identifiable stressor.

subtypes.With Depressed Mood: Symptoms mainly include low mood, tearfulness, or feelings of hopelessness.
subtypes.With Anxiety: Symptoms mainly include nervousness, worry, jitteriness, or separation anxiety.
subtypes.With Mixed Anxiety and Depressed Mood: A combination of depression and anxiety symptoms appears.
subtypes.With Disturbance of Conduct: Symptoms mainly involve violation of rules, truancy, vandalism, reckless driving, or fighting.
subtypes.With Mixed Disturbance of Emotions and C: Both emotional symptoms (depression, anxiety) and behavioral problems appear together.
subtypes.Unspecified: Maladaptive reactions not classified into the above types (e.g., physical complaints, social withdrawal).

patient_info.stressor_event: Son or daughter leaving home (marriage, attending college, joined military)
patient_info.stressor: Patricia Allen’s only daughter left Charleston for basic training after months of insisting she wanted independence, and Patricia, who had organized much of her adult life around work, art, and parenting, found the sudden emptiness of the house harder to absorb than expected. Over the next month Patricia’s stress-related reactions grew from private distress into behavior that interfered with fabrication deadlines, mentoring junior workers, and the careful routines required for safe metalwork. The change became clinically significant when their supervisor removed them from a complex welding assignment after repeated coordination problems and encouraged them to use the company’s employee assistance program. Patricia initially resisted, but after abandoning a planned sculpture submission and withdrawing from paddle-boarding and gallery visits, they accepted an EAP referral to psychiatric care.

S081.name: Stress_Related_Maladaptive_Response
S081.description: Emotional or behavioral symptoms appearing in response to an identifiable stressor.
S081.manifestation: Since my daughter left for basic training, I feel like I come home to a dead house and I can’t keep myself together—I'm crying in the truck before shifts, missing steps on welding jobs I’ve done for years, snapping at the younger guys, and I’ve stopped going out on the water or working on my sculpture because I just don’t see the point.

additional_requirement_1.name: Additional Requirement 1
additional_requirement_1.description: Symptoms must develop within 3 months of the onset of the stressor
additional_requirement_1.manifestation: I was managing okay before my daughter shipped out, and this all started within a few weeks of her leaving for basic training.

additional_requirement_2.name: Additional Requirement 2
additional_requirement_2.description: Within 6 months of the termination of the stressor or its consequences
additional_requirement_2.manifestation: This is still tied to her being gone and the house feeling empty; I’m not dealing with something that ended a long time ago.

functional_impairment.name: Functional Impairment
functional_impairment.manifestation: My supervisor took me off a complex welding job because I wasn’t coordinating safely enough, and I let a sculpture submission pass without finishing it.

duration.name: Duration
duration.manifestation: It’s been about a month since my daughter left, and I’ve been struggling like this since then.
